title: Training-size curve
explanation: Smaller stratified parts of the training sample: how the accuracy grows with its size.
settings: 25, 50 and 75 % of each class of the training sample (rounded half up), 20 repetitions each, seeds 42 … 61; 100 % is the design as given. The test sample is classified.
description: An evaluation design on the article's split files (ADR-095): every method of the comparison with fixed settings, the classified objects without their class. Percentages with two decimals.
